name: Kyouka Jikken ~Yamato Nadeshiko Nikutai Kaizou~
original_name: 狂化実験～大和撫子肉体改造～
source:
A young girl has given her body over to experimental modification, for the sake of the nation's soldiers, to see if life can be restored from the brink of death or beyond. But what happens to her body is far stranger... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061091.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为了国家的士兵，一名少女自愿献出身体接受改造实验，研究者希望借此确认生命能否从濒死状态、甚至死亡彼岸恢复。然而，她身体上发生的变化远比想象中诡异……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061091.html]DLsite English[/url]]
